gancho: After the feast of Aegir, where Loki insulted every god in the hall, the gods hunted him down: a salmon in a waterfall, a net woven from ashes, and a chain made of his own son's entrails. Now he lies beneath a dripping serpent, and when his wife's bowl runs full, the whole earth shakes.
capitulos: Tyr, Njord, Heimdall, Sif and Skadi
